c44445.title: Architecture and static triage results
c44445.content: No application repository is mounted under /workspace; only captured frontend HTML was saved at source-arch/index.html. Thus source route/model inspection and true repo static scans are unavailable. Bounded tools ran against workspace artifact: semgrep found only missing SRI on Nuxt dev module script (low-confidence audit); gitleaks/trufflehog found no secrets; trivy found no detected config/dependency files; ast-grep only scanned HTML. Frontend `GET /` on :3002 is Nuxt dev build and HTML leaks absolute local paths (`/_nuxt/Users/heyrcg/Documents/Works/gioi/...`) plus `buildId:'dev'`, API base `https://gioi-api.vercel.app`. API `GET /openapi.json`, `/docs`, `/` return Fastify JSON 404. CORS preflight to `POST /public/venues/bali/reservations` with Origin http://evil.test returned 204 with `access-control-allow-origin: http://evil.test` and `access-control-allow-credentials:true`, methods all CRUD; this confirms reflected credentialed CORS behavior. Threat model saved for :3001.

201f8a.title: Nuxt frontend recon and exposed dev source
201f8a.content:
Frontend :3002 runs Nuxt dev server (`x-powered-by: Nuxt`, buildId dev). Root HTML leaks absolute source paths and Vite assets. Any source file under `/ _nuxt/Users/heyrcg/Documents/Works/gioi/apps/web/...` is directly retrievable as transformed JS (e.g. `pages/admin/index.vue` 130KB, `pages/host.vue`, `pages/login.vue`, `pages/guests/[id].vue`, `composables/useApi.ts`, `stores/auth.ts`, `middleware/auth.ts`, `middleware/admin.ts`). `/ _nuxt/@vite/client` is exposed (179KB). `window.__NUXT__.config.public.apiBase` is `https://gioi-api.vercel.app`; proxy uses `/api` with `credentials: include`.

Routes observed: `/`, `/bali`, `/bali/book`, `/privacy`, `/login`, `/host`, `/admin`, `/admin/venues`, `/admin/reservations`, `/guests/:id`; `/host` and unknown staff paths SSR 500 due dev/runtime issues but source modules are retrievable. `robots.txt` disallows `/login,/host,/admin,/guests,/ingest`.

Extracted API surface from exposed `composables/useApi.ts`: `/staff/me`, `/staff/day`, POST `/staff/reservations`, PATCH `/staff/reservations/:id`, POST `/staff/reservations/:id/status`, GET `/staff/reservations/:id/next-statuses`, `/staff/guests`, `/staff/guests/:id`; `/admin/audit-log`, `/admin/analytics`, `/admin/venues/:id` (GET/PATCH), opening-hours GET/PUT, closed-dates GET/PUT, `/admin/users` GET/PUT/POST, DELETE `/admin/users/:id`, `/admin/venues` GET/POST, `/admin/venues/:id/export.csv`, floor-plan GET + layout/image PUT; auth POST `/staff/login`, `/staff/logout`. Public booking page uses GET `/api/public/venues/:slug`, `/availability`, `/floor-plan` and submits reservation (body fields guestName, phone,email,date,time,partySize,seatingAreaId,occasion,guestNotes,etc).

Auth middleware is client route guard only; `auth` middleware redirects when no store user, admin middleware checks `isAdmin` and super-admin for `/admin/audit`; API authorization must be independently enforced.

38ec66.title: Fastify API route inventory and seeded creds
38ec66.content: Fetched API source via exposed Nuxt Vite paths (`/_nuxt/@fs/Users/.../apps/api/src/...`). API modules reveal routes: public GET `/public/venues/:slug`, `/public/venues/:slug/availability`, POST `/public/venues/:slug/reservations`; GET `/public/reservations/:code`, POST `/public/reservations/:code/cancel`, `/feedback`; GET `/public/venues/:slug/floor-plan`. Auth POST `/staff/login`, `/staff/logout`, GET `/staff/me`. Staff GET `/staff/day`, POST `/staff/reservations`, PATCH `/staff/reservations/:id`, POST `/staff/reservations/:id/status`, GET `/staff/reservations/:id/next-statuses`, `/staff/guests/:id`, `/staff/guests`. Admin routes GET/PATCH `/admin/venues/:id`; GET/PUT opening-hours and closed-dates; GET/POST `/admin/venues`; GET/POST/PUT `/admin/users`, DELETE `/admin/users/:userId`; GET `/admin/audit-log`, `/admin/analytics`, `/admin/venues/:id/export.csv`; floor plan GET `/admin/venues/:id/floor-plan`, PUT layout/image. Seed accounts admin (superadmin), host (host role), venueadmin (admin role), venue `bali`; all password `password`. Login cookie `gioi_session` has HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 604800, Path=/; no Domain. Runtime CORS defaults origin true + credentials true when CORS_ORIGIN unset. Source files saved temporarily under /tmp/recon.
